## Checklist

- [ ] The project is a complete independent website, not an unfinished starter.
- [ ] Manifest id/order are valid and unique; the site has extension notes.
- [ ] The first screen prioritizes actual content or controls.
- [ ] Essential text, keyboard/touch behavior, and a 375px layout are usable.
- [ ] Motion can be paused; audio/microphone use is explicit and cleaned up.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, tracking, or undocumented network calls are included.
- [ ] Model limitations and fictional information are labeled honestly.
- [ ] Originality/licensing and any imported assets are explained.
- [ ] Build and relevant behavior coverage pass.
- [ ] The committed cover represents the actual project.
